# skygo dashboard refuses every listener that is not 127.0.0.1 or [::1]
# before binding or contacting the endpoint.
# Run by TestDashboardScripts; needs the cli.go dashboardCommand registration.
env SKYGO_TOKEN=dashboard-token
! skygo --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:1 dashboard --listen 0.0.0.0:0
stderr 'dashboard listens only on a loopback address'
! stdout .
! skygo --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:1 dashboard --listen localhost:0
stderr 'dashboard listens only on a loopback address'
! skygo --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:1 dashboard --listen 10.0.0.1:0
stderr 'dashboard listens only on a loopback address'
! skygo --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:1 dashboard --listen 127.0.0.2:0
stderr 'dashboard listens only on a loopback address'
! skygo --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:1 dashboard --listen '[::]:0'
stderr 'dashboard listens only on a loopback address'
! skygo --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:1 dashboard --listen '[::ffff:127.0.0.1]:0'
stderr 'dashboard listens only on a loopback address'
! skygo --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:1 dashboard --listen '[fe80::1%lo0]:0'
stderr 'dashboard listens only on a loopback address'
! skygo --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:1 dashboard --listen :0
stderr 'dashboard listens only on a loopback address'
! skygo --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:1 dashboard --listen 127.0.0.1:65536
stderr 'invalid dashboard port'
! stderr 'login code'
! skygo --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:1 dashboard extra
stderr 'unknown command|accepts 0 arg'
! stderr 'dashboard-token'
